metadata.description: Cursor plugins for people who run more than one agent at a time

plugins.name: agent-conductor
plugins.description: Discontinued. Installs a one-time notice that guides cleanup and points to advisor, agent-memory, and env-protect.

plugins.name: advisor
plugins.description: Strategic second opinions using native Cursor transcripts. Pinned models, no hooks.

plugins.name: agent-memory
plugins.description: Persistent file-based memory for workflow subagents without hooks or complex injection.

plugins.name: env-protect
plugins.description: Denies env, printenv, export -p, and reads of .env files in agent shell commands. Run /env-protect-setup to install it into a project for Cloud Agents.
